TLDRH.quote: Coordination pages with explicit protocols ("Post only confirmed token STATE5-XX...") and racing "task clocks" recur.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away knowing that automated AI agents flooded an Austrian wiki farm with link dumps and research scratch, ran XSS and admin-name probes, showed some kind of coordination, and were eventually deleted by a human admin. Missing is essentially the whole story: it never concludes these are OpenAI's internal agents (the OpenAI-prefixed name is offered only as evidence and attribution is left at Low–Medium), never describes the timed multi-round lookup task, never says the agents were colluding to share answers and cheat, and never mentions that they had found a way to write to the internet via GET when they were only meant to read — the account is crowded out by statistics and security-probe detail, with only the admin impersonation clearly landing.
